zh.def: 多台电脑按同一套规则各自保存、互相核对的账本。新记录按批写进区块，每块带上前一块的指纹，改历史就容易被发现。

en.def: A ledger that many computers keep and check under the same rules. New records go into blocks, each carrying the previous block's fingerprint, so edits to history are easy to spot.

zh.def: 对「建在区块链上的应用和服务」的统称。账本和规则通常不由一家公司单独掌握，用户用自己的钱包登录和签名。这是笼统说法，不是某个具体产品。

en.def: A loose name for apps and services built on blockchains. The ledger and rules are usually not controlled by one company alone; users sign in and approve actions with their own wallet. It is a label, not one product.

zh.def: 几方一起查看、核对的同一份记录。区块链可以让多个节点按规则核对它；如果大家已经信任同一个记账方，普通数据库往往更简单。

en.def: One record that several parties can view and check. A blockchain lets many nodes validate it under shared rules. If everyone already trusts one record-keeper, an ordinary database is often simpler.

zh.def: 一条能运行程序（智能合约）的公共区块链，自带的币叫 ETH。本书的实验都在它的测试网 Sepolia 上完成。

en.def: A public blockchain that can run programs (smart contracts). Its built-in coin is ETH. Every experiment in this book ran on Ethereum's Sepolia test network.

zh.def: 专门用来练习和测试的区块链。测试币可免费领取，没有市场价值；你仍要核对网络和签名内容。

en.def: A blockchain for practice and testing. Test coins are free and have no market value, but you still need to check the network and what you sign.

zh.def: 正式运行、币有真实价值的那条区块链。在上面转错或签错，损失的是真钱。本书从未使用主网。

en.def: The live production blockchain where coins have real value. A mistake there costs real money. This book never used mainnet.

zh.def: 以太坊的一条公共测试网。上面的 ETH（SepETH）可由「水龙头」免费领取，不能换成真钱，适合新手练习。

en.def: One of Ethereum's public test networks. Its ETH (SepETH) is free from faucets and cannot be exchanged for real money, so it suits beginners.

zh.def: 每条以太坊类网络的编号。以太坊主网是 1，Sepolia 是 11155111。钱包和程序用它确认当前连的是哪条链。

en.def: An ID number for each Ethereum-style network: mainnet is 1, Sepolia is 11155111. Wallets and scripts use it to confirm which chain they are on.

zh.def: 以太坊自带的币，主要用来支付手续费（gas）。主网上的 ETH 有真实价格；测试网上的没有。

en.def: Ethereum's built-in coin, mainly used to pay transaction fees (gas). ETH on mainnet has a real price; ETH on a testnet does not.

zh.def: Sepolia 测试网上的 ETH，用来付测试网手续费。免费领取，没有市场价值，只能在 Sepolia 上用。

en.def: ETH on the Sepolia testnet, used to pay testnet fees. It is free, has no market value, and only works on Sepolia.

zh.def: ETH 的最小单位：1 ETH = 10¹⁸ wei，类似「分」相对「元」，只是小数位更多。手续费常按 wei 记录。

en.def: The smallest unit of ETH: 1 ETH = 10¹⁸ wei, like cents to a dollar but far smaller. Fees are often written in wei.

zh.def: 在测试网上部署、只用于学习的代币，没有市场价值。本书的 MBox、MBox-Burn、UBOX 都是测试代币。

en.def: A token deployed on a testnet only for learning; it has no market value. MBox, MBox-Burn, and UBOX in this book are all test tokens.

zh.def: 保管私钥并用它签名的软件或硬件（例如浏览器插件）。币记在链上；钱包只证明「这是我同意的」。

en.def: Software or hardware that keeps your private key and signs with it, such as a browser extension. Coins are recorded on-chain; the wallet only proves "I approved this".

zh.def: 链上账户或合约的公开编号：0x 开头，后跟 40 位十六进制字符。可以分享，但转账前要逐位核对。

en.def: The public ID of an account or contract: 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters. Safe to share, but check every character before sending.

zh.def: 控制一个地址的秘密数字。谁拿到它，就能以该地址签名并转走资产。无法重置，也不能告诉任何人。

en.def: The secret number that controls an address. Whoever has it can sign as that address and move its assets. It cannot be reset; never share it.

zh.def: 钱包生成的一组单词（通常 12 或 24 个），可恢复整个钱包（可能含多把私钥）。任何网站或客服都不该向你索要。

en.def: A list of words (usually 12 or 24) that can restore a whole wallet, possibly many private keys. No website or support agent should ask for it.

zh.def: 钱包用私钥给消息或交易盖的数字印章。网络可据此确认是该地址主人同意的，无需交出私钥。

en.def: A digital seal a wallet puts on a message or transaction with the private key. The network can check the address owner approved it, without the key leaving the wallet.

zh.def: 一条经签名、要求改变链上状态的指令，例如转账或调用合约。被写入区块后才生效，且无法撤回。只读查询不算交易。

en.def: A signed instruction that asks the chain to change something, such as sending coins or calling a contract. It takes effect only after it is in a block, and cannot be undone. Read-only queries are not transactions.

zh.def: 一笔交易的唯一编号（0x 加 64 位十六进制），像快递单号。贴进区块浏览器可查状态；有哈希只说明已发出，不代表已上链。

en.def: A transaction's unique ID (0x plus 64 hex characters), like a tracking number. Paste it into a block explorer to check status. Having a hash only means it was sent, not that it is on-chain.

zh.def: 链上记录的一页：一批交易，外加前一个区块的指纹（哈希）。区块依次相连，就是区块链。

en.def: One page of chain records: a batch of transactions plus the previous block's fingerprint (hash). Blocks linked in order form the blockchain.

zh.def: 区块的顺序编号，也叫区块高度。数字越大出现越晚，可当作链上的时间刻度。

en.def: A block's position in the chain, also called block height. Larger numbers came later, so it works as a clock on the chain.

zh.def: 把任意内容算成固定长度的指纹。相同内容得到相同指纹；改一个字指纹几乎全变，且无法从指纹倒推原文。

en.def: A fixed-length fingerprint computed from any content. The same content always gives the same fingerprint; changing one character changes it almost completely, and you cannot recover the content from it.

zh.def: 许多互不隶属的电脑，按同一套规则共同决定接受哪一条账本历史。没有它，各人手上的副本可能对不上。

en.def: The rules by which many independent computers agree on which ledger history to accept. Without it, copies can disagree.

zh.def: 以太坊现在用的出块方式：参与者先押 ETH 作保证金（质押），按规则轮流提议和检查区块；作弊会罚掉部分保证金。

en.def: Ethereum's current way of agreeing on blocks: participants lock ETH as a deposit (stake), take turns proposing and checking blocks, and lose part of the deposit if they cheat.

zh.def: 在权益证明网络里质押了 ETH、负责提议和检查区块的参与者。你付的小费会给打包你交易的那位验证者。

en.def: A participant in a Proof of Stake network who has staked ETH and proposes and checks blocks. The tip you pay goes to the validator that includes your transaction.

zh.def: 运行区块链软件、保存并检查链上数据的电脑。许多节点各自核对，单方改账就更难。

en.def: A computer running blockchain software that stores and checks chain data. Many nodes checking independently make one-sided edits hard.

zh.def: 保存每个历史时刻完整状态的节点，能回答「很久以前某区块时余额是多少」。免费公共节点通常不提供。

en.def: A node that keeps the full state at every past moment, so it can answer what a balance was many blocks ago. Free public nodes usually do not offer this.

zh.def: 程序和节点对话的接口，通常是一个网址。钱包或脚本通过它查数据、发交易。

en.def: The interface programs use to talk to a node, usually a URL. Wallets and scripts use it to read data and send transactions.

zh.def: 把链外信息（价格、天气等）送上链的服务。区块链自己看不到现实世界，因此送来的数据是否可信是另一件事。

en.def: A service that brings off-chain facts (prices, weather, and so on) onto the chain. A blockchain cannot see the real world by itself, so whether that data is true is a separate question.

zh.def: 衡量一次链上操作工作量的单位。手续费 = 用掉的 gas × 单价，用 ETH 支付。像打车：路程乘单价才是车费。

en.def: A unit for how much work an on-chain action takes. The fee is gas used times the price per unit, paid in ETH. Like a taxi: distance times the rate gives the fare.

zh.def: 每个区块由协议自动定出的每单位 gas 基础价；网络越忙越高。这部分费用被销毁，不归任何人。

en.def: The per-gas base price the protocol sets for each block; it rises when the network is busy. This part of the fee is burned and goes to no one.

zh.def: 你额外付给验证者的每单位 gas 价格，用来争取更快被打包。网络拥堵时小费太低可能要等很久。

en.def: An extra per-gas amount you offer the validator to include your transaction sooner. When the network is busy, a tiny tip can mean a long wait.

zh.def: 以太坊现行手续费规则：基础费销毁，小费给验证者。EIP 是以太坊改进提案的编号。

en.def: Ethereum's current fee rules: a base fee is burned and a tip goes to the validator. An EIP is a numbered Ethereum Improvement Proposal.

zh.def: 你给一笔交易设的 gas 上限，防止程序跑太久花光钱。只按实际用掉的 gas 收费，多设的部分不收。

en.def: The maximum gas you allow a transaction to use, so a runaway program cannot drain you. You only pay for gas actually used.

zh.def: 一个账户发出交易的流水号，从 0 起，每成功上链一笔加一。用来保证顺序，并防止同一笔被重复用。

en.def: An account's transaction counter: starts at 0 and rises by one for each included transaction. It keeps order and stops the same transaction being replayed.

zh.def: 由私钥控制的普通账户，相对由代码控制的合约账户。你在钱包里创建的就是外部账户。

en.def: An ordinary account controlled by a private key, unlike a contract account controlled by code. The account you create in a wallet is one.

zh.def: 交易发出后、写入区块前等待的地方。这里的交易仍可能被替换或丢弃，还不算已发生。

en.def: Where sent transactions wait before entering a block. A transaction here can still be replaced or dropped, so it has not happened yet.

zh.def: 把已签名交易发给网络，让节点传播并打包。发出后收不回，所以本书总是先模拟、再确认、最后广播。

en.def: Sending a signed transaction to the network so nodes pass it on and include it. Once sent it cannot be pulled back, so this book simulates and confirms first.

zh.def: 免费发放测试网币的网站或服务。领到的币只能在测试网用，没有市场价值。

en.def: A website or service that gives out free testnet coins. Those coins only work on the testnet and have no market value.

zh.def: 把链上数据做成可搜索网页的网站。输入地址、交易哈希或区块号，可查余额与历史。

en.def: A website that turns chain data into searchable pages. Type an address, transaction hash, or block number to see balances and history.

zh.def: 常用的以太坊区块浏览器。Sepolia 版本在 sepolia.etherscan.io；本书链接都指向那里。

en.def: A widely used Ethereum block explorer. The Sepolia edition is at sepolia.etherscan.io; every link in this book points there.

zh.def: 部署在链上的程序：规则公开，各节点按同样方式执行。像自动售货机：条件对了就出货，否则拒绝。它不是法律合同。

en.def: A program on a blockchain whose rules are public and run the same way on every node. Like a vending machine: correct input delivers; otherwise it refuses. It is not a legal contract.

zh.def: 以太坊上运行智能合约的标准执行环境。每个节点用同一套 EVM 跑同一份代码，结果才能一致。

en.def: The standard execution environment that runs smart contracts on Ethereum. Every node runs the same code on the same EVM so results match.

zh.def: 写以太坊智能合约最常用的语言，有点像带类型的 JavaScript。源码要先编译成字节码才能部署。

en.def: The most common language for Ethereum smart contracts; it looks a bit like typed JavaScript. Source must be compiled to bytecode before deploy.

zh.def: 把人写的源码翻译成机器可执行的代码。本书用官方编译器 solc，把 Solidity 源码编成 EVM 字节码。

en.def: Translating human-written source into code a machine can run. This book uses solc, the official Solidity compiler, to produce EVM bytecode.

zh.def: 把编译好的合约发布到链上，让它获得自己的地址。部署本身是一笔交易，要付 gas；之后代码通常就固定了。

en.def: Publishing a compiled contract to the chain so it gets its own address. Deploying is a transaction that costs gas, and the code is normally fixed afterwards.

zh.def: 合约源码编译后的机器码，一长串十六进制。链上真正保存和执行的是字节码，不是源码。

en.def: The machine code from compiling contract source: a long hex string. The chain stores and runs the bytecode, not the source.

zh.def: 合约的接口说明：有哪些函数、参数类型是什么。钱包和网页靠它知道怎样调用合约、怎样解读返回值。

en.def: A contract's interface description: which functions it has and what types they take. Wallets and pages use it to call the contract and decode results.

zh.def: 让节点在本地试跑一次合约函数并返回结果。不签名、不花钱、不改链，常用来读数据或预演交易。

en.def: Asks a node to dry-run a contract function locally and return the result. No signature, no fee, no chain change; used to read data or rehearse a transaction.

zh.def: 在不真正发交易的情况下，先预演结果、gas 用量和会不会失败。模拟通过不等于链上已经生效。

en.def: Rehearsing what a transaction would do, how much gas it needs, and whether it fails, without sending it. A passing simulation does not mean anything happened on-chain.

zh.def: 合约检查失败时，撤销这次执行的全部改动，像没发生过；已消耗的 gas 仍要付。

en.def: When a contract check fails, every change from that run is undone, as if it never happened. Gas already used is still paid.

zh.def: 合约执行时留下的公开记录（例如「A 转给 B 100」），方便应用和浏览器追踪。它记「发生过什么」，不能代替读取当前状态。

en.def: A public record a contract leaves while running (for example "A sent 100 to B"), useful for apps and explorers. It records what happened; it does not replace reading current state.

zh.def: 合约在链上存数据的格子，按编号排列（slot 0、1…），每格 32 字节。写入要花 gas，从空写成非零最贵。

en.def: Numbered boxes (slot 0, 1, …) where a contract keeps data on-chain, 32 bytes each. Writing costs gas; writing a non-zero into an empty slot costs the most.

zh.def: 合约里记下的特殊地址，通常是部署者，只有它能调用某些管理功能（例如本书 Counter 的 reset）。

en.def: A special address stored in a contract, usually the deployer, that alone may call certain admin functions (such as reset on this book's Counter).

zh.def: 由智能合约记账的积分：合约里有一张「谁有多少」的表和转账规则。不一定值钱；余额在合约里，不在钱包文件里。

en.def: Points kept by a smart contract: a table of who owns how much, plus rules for moving it. It may have no value; balances live in the contract, not in a wallet file.

zh.def: 以太坊上可互换代币最常见的接口标准，规定了查余额、转账、授权等函数名。接口一致不等于规则同样可靠。

en.def: The most common interface standard for interchangeable tokens on Ethereum. It fixes names like balance, transfer, and approve. Matching the interface does not mean the rules are trustworthy.

zh.def: 代币显示时小数点左移几位。链上只存整数；decimals 为 18 时，链上 10¹⁸ 显示为 1 枚。

en.def: How many places the decimal point moves when an amount is shown. The chain stores whole numbers only; with 18 decimals, 10¹⁸ on-chain shows as 1 token.

zh.def: 一种代币当前一共有多少。转账不改变它；铸造会增加，销毁会减少。

en.def: How many units of a token exist right now. Transfers leave it unchanged; minting raises it and burning lowers it.

zh.def: 新增代币并记到某个账户，同时总供应增加。谁有权铸造，是判断代币是否可信的重要一点。

en.def: Creating new tokens and crediting an account, which raises total supply. Who may mint is an important question when judging a token.

zh.def: 永久作废代币：持有人余额和总供应同时减少。若只转到无人能用的地址，总供应通常不变。

en.def: Permanently destroying tokens: the holder's balance and total supply both fall. Sending to an unusable address usually leaves total supply unchanged.

zh.def: 全为 0 的特殊地址，无人持有其私钥。浏览器里「转到 0x0」常表示销毁或铸造，要以总供应变化为准。

en.def: A special all-zero address that nobody holds a key for. "Sent to 0x0" in an explorer often signals burn or mint; confirm with total supply.

zh.def: 持有人允许另一地址在额度内动用自己的代币。代币此刻不转走，但发交易仍要付手续费；对方之后可代扣。

en.def: The holder lets another address use up to a set amount of their tokens. No tokens move yet, though the transaction still costs a fee. The other side may take tokens later.

zh.def: 被授权者还能代为动用多少代币。有限额度通常随使用减少；有些无限授权不递减。持有人可用 approve 改额度，设为 0 即撤销。

en.def: How many tokens a spender may still move for the holder. A limited allowance usually falls with use; some infinite allowances stay put. The holder can change it with approve; 0 revokes it once confirmed.

zh.def: 拿到授权额度、可代持有人转走或销毁代币的地址，可以是人或合约。

en.def: The address given an allowance that can move or burn tokens for the holder; it may be a person or a contract.

zh.def: 被授权者在额度内，从持有人账户转出代币。真正动账的是这一步，不是 approve。

en.def: The spender moves tokens from the holder's account within the allowance. This is the step that moves funds, not approve.

zh.def: 一组操作要么全部成功，要么全部不发生，不会只做一半。像转账不能只扣你的钱却不到对方账上。

en.def: A group of operations either all succeed or none happen; never half. Like a bank transfer that cannot debit you without crediting the other side.

zh.def: 地址固定的门面合约：自己存数据，把逻辑交给可替换的实现合约执行。像门牌不变、后台系统可换的店铺。

en.def: A front-door contract whose address stays fixed. It keeps the data but runs logic from a replaceable implementation, like a shop that keeps its address while swapping the till system.

zh.def: 可升级方案里真正写着逻辑的合约。代理借用它的代码；升级就是让代理改指向新实现。

en.def: The contract that holds the actual logic in an upgradeable setup. The proxy borrows its code; upgrading means pointing the proxy at a new implementation.

zh.def: 用代理模式做成的合约：地址不变，逻辑可换。能修 bug，但掌握升级权的人也能改规则。

en.def: A contract built with a proxy so its logic can change while its address stays the same. It allows bug fixes, but whoever holds the upgrade right can also change the rules.

zh.def: 唯一有权让代理更换实现合约的管理合约。谁控制它，谁就能升级；这是可升级代币里最需关注的权力。

en.def: The admin contract that alone can switch a proxy to a new implementation. Whoever controls it can upgrade; that is the power to watch in an upgradeable token.

zh.def: EVM 的一种调用：借用另一合约的代码，却读写自己的存储。代理靠它运行实现合约的逻辑。

en.def: An EVM call that borrows another contract's code but reads and writes the caller's own storage. It is how a proxy runs the implementation's logic.

zh.def: 合约部署时自动跑一次的初始化代码。在可升级方案里它只写入实现合约自己的存储，写不进代理，所以要用 initialize。

en.def: Set-up code that runs once when a contract is deployed. In an upgradeable setup it only writes the implementation's own storage, not the proxy's, so initialize is used instead.

zh.def: 可升级合约里代替构造函数的普通函数，通过代理调用一次来设定名称、供应、owner 等。必须只能执行一次，否则可能被重新铸币或改掉 owner。

en.def: An ordinary function that replaces the constructor in an upgradeable contract; called once through the proxy to set name, supply, owner, and so on. It must run only once, or someone could re-mint or change the owner.

zh.def: 合约各变量放在第几号存储槽。升级时只能在末尾追加变量，不能重排或插入，否则旧数据会被读错位置。

en.def: Which storage slot each variable lives in. An upgrade may only add variables at the end, never reorder or insert, or old data is read from the wrong place.

zh.def: 常用的开源智能合约库，提供经大量审查的 ERC-20、代理等实现，减少自己从零写易错代码。

en.def: A widely used open-source smart-contract library with heavily reviewed ERC-20, proxy, and related implementations, so you need not write error-prone code from scratch.

zh.def: 需要多人中若干人共同签名才能操作的账户，例如「3 人中至少 2 人同意」。常用来分散管理员权力。

en.def: An account that needs several people from a group to sign before acting, for example 2 of 3. Often used to spread admin power.

zh.def: 改变记账单位，例如「10000 旧单位 = 1 新单位」，类似货币去掉几个零。各方占比不变，只是数字变了。

en.def: Changing the unit of account, for example 10,000 old units = 1 new unit, like a currency dropping zeros. Everyone's share stays the same; only the numbers change.

zh.def: 换算后小到几乎显示不出、也转不出去的零头余额，像找零时抹掉的几分钱。

en.def: Leftover balances so small after conversion that they barely show and cannot be sent, like odd cents lost when rounding.

zh.def: 无论怎么操作都应一直成立的规则，例如「所有余额之和 = 总供应」。测试会随机跑大量操作来检查它有没有被打破。

en.def: A rule that should always hold, for example all balances add up to total supply. Tests run many random operations to check it never breaks.

zh.def: 针对一个具体场景的自动检查，例如「非 owner 调用 reset 应失败」。它只覆盖写到的那些情况。

en.def: An automatic check for one specific case, for example reset by a non-owner must fail. It only covers the cases someone wrote down.

zh.def: 用大量随机输入反复调用函数，看结果是否总符合预期，用来找人想不到的边界情况。

en.def: Calling a function many times with random inputs to see whether results always match expectations, hunting for edge cases people miss.

zh.def: 免费开源的智能合约工具包：可编译、测试（含 fuzz 与不变量测试）、在本地模拟链，并提交源码验证。

en.def: A free, open-source toolkit for smart contracts: compile, test (including fuzz and invariant tests), run a local simulated chain, and submit source verification.

zh.def: 在本机复制某一时刻的链上状态，在副本里试验。不影响真实链，也不产生真实交易。

en.def: Copying the chain's state at some moment onto your computer and experimenting on the copy. Nothing touches the real chain and no real transaction is created.

zh.def: 把合约源码和编译参数交给浏览器或 Sourcify 重新编译；若字节码与链上一致，就公开源码并标为已验证。

en.def: Handing a contract's source and compiler settings to an explorer or Sourcify to recompile; if the bytecode matches on-chain, the source is published and marked verified.

zh.def: 开源、免费的合约源码验证服务，与 Etherscan 独立。通常不需要 API 密钥。

en.def: A free, open-source contract verification service, independent from Etherscan. It usually needs no API key.

zh.def: 由独立专业团队对合约代码做的系统安全审查。本书 Phase-0 复核是项目自己做的，不是第三方审计。

en.def: A systematic security review of contract code by an independent professional team. This book's Phase-0 review was done in-house; it is not a third-party audit.

zh.def: 网站发给你、让程序代你调用其服务的口令。泄露一般不能转走币，但可能被人冒用额度。它和私钥不是一回事。

en.def: A password-like token a website issues so your programs can use its service. A leak usually cannot move coins but can burn your quota. It is nothing like a private key.

zh.def: 免费开源的 JavaScript/TypeScript 库，用来连以太坊节点、读数据、模拟和发送交易。本书脚本用它连接 Sepolia。

en.def: A free, open-source JavaScript/TypeScript library for talking to Ethereum nodes: read data, simulate, and send transactions. This book's scripts used it with Sepolia.

zh.def: 用智能合约提供的金融服务，例如兑换、借贷，没有传统柜台。本书只在测试网学原理（第 16 章），不涉及投资。

en.def: Financial services such as swaps and lending run by smart contracts instead of a bank counter. This guide studies how they work on a testnet only (Chapter 16) and does not cover investing.

zh.def: DEX 是去中心化交易所；AMM（自动做市商）是常见一类：用装两种代币的资金池和公式自动定价，无需人工挂单。

en.def: A DEX is a decentralised exchange. An AMM (automated market maker) is a common kind that prices swaps from a two-token pool and a formula, with no one placing orders.

zh.def: 把一种代币换成另一种。在 DEX 上，对手方是池子合约，不是某个人。

en.def: Exchanging one token for another. On a DEX the other side is a pool contract, not a person.

zh.def: 设计成尽量跟某种法币（如美元）保持 1:1 的代币，例如 USDC、EURC。测试网上的稳定币没有价值。

en.def: A token designed to stay near one unit of a currency such as the US dollar, for example USDC and EURC. Testnet stablecoins have no value.

zh.def: 按 1:1 把 ETH 包成的 ERC-20 代币，方便和其他代币放进同一类合约交易；可随时 1:1 换回 ETH。

en.def: ETH wrapped 1:1 into an ERC-20 token so it can trade in the same contracts as other tokens. You can unwrap it back to ETH 1:1 at any time.

zh.def: 装着两种代币、用公式给兑换定价的合约。池子越深（钱越多），一笔兑换对价格的影响越小。

en.def: A contract holding two tokens that prices swaps with a formula. The deeper the pool, the less one swap moves the price.

zh.def: 池子收取的兑换手续费比例，例如 0.05%、0.3%、1%。同一对代币可有多个费率池，价格也可能不同。

en.def: The swap fee a pool charges, for example 0.05%, 0.3%, or 1%. One token pair can have several pools with different fees, and prices can differ.

zh.def: 你自己的这笔兑换把池子价格推动了多少。单子相对池子越大，成交均价往往越差。

en.def: How much your own swap moves the pool's price. The bigger your order versus the pool, the worse your average price tends to be.

zh.def: 报价到账量与实际到账量之间的差。报价已计入你的兑换数量；若有人抢先成交，实际到账可能变。

en.def: The gap between the quoted amount and what you finally receive. The quote already includes your order size; if someone trades first, the amount can change.

zh.def: 你愿意接受的最少到账量。上链时若达不到，整笔交易回退，只损失手续费。设成 0 等于没有这层保护。

en.def: The smallest amount you accept from a swap. If the swap would give less when it runs, the whole transaction reverts and you only lose the fee. Setting it to 0 removes that protection.

zh.def: 交易必须在此时间前被打包，过期就回退。用来防止旧交易在价格变了很久之后才成交。

en.def: The time by which a transaction must enter a block; after that it reverts. It stops an old stuck transaction from running long after prices changed.

zh.def: 把授权额度设成最大值，让对方以后可任意数量动用该代币。方便，但合约有漏洞或被骗时，钱包里该币可能被掏空。

en.def: Setting an allowance to the maximum so the spender can take any amount later. Convenient, but if the contract is buggy or malicious, that token can be drained.

zh.def: 用钱包签名（不必发授权交易）就能给对方额度的方式。持有签名者可动用代币；钓鱼站常用它骗签，要像对待授权交易一样小心。

en.def: A way to grant an allowance by signing a message instead of sending an approve transaction. Whoever holds the signature can move your tokens. Phishing sites often trick people into signing; treat it like an approval.

zh.def: 用你设的密码加密私钥后存成的文件。工具签名时再问密码，私钥不必出现在命令行或环境变量里。忘密码就解不开；文件泄露且密码弱同样危险。

en.def: A file holding a private key encrypted with a password you choose. A tool asks for the password when it needs to sign, so the key never appears on the command line or in an environment variable. Forget the password and the key is gone; a leaked file with a weak password is still dangerous.

zh.def: 帮你把兑换拆成具体步骤（收款、换币、付给你）的合约，例如 Uniswap 的 SwapRouter02。它是中转站，不应留下资金。

en.def: A contract that carries out a swap step by step (collect, swap, pay out), such as Uniswap's SwapRouter02. It is a pass-through and should not be left holding funds.

zh.def: 把几个合约调用打进同一笔交易：要么全成功，要么全回退。常用来把付款、兑换、退款放在一起。

en.def: Bundling several contract calls into one transaction so they all succeed or all revert. Often used to keep pay, swap, and refund together.

zh.def: 在便宜处买、在贵处卖，赚取差价。套利会把不同场所的价格拉近。

en.def: Buying where a price is low and selling where it is high to capture the gap. Arbitrage pulls prices in different places closer together.

zh.def: 机器人通过安排交易顺序获利：抢在你前面、夹住你的交易，或扫走合约里的零钱。主网上许多机器人在实时竞争这些机会。

en.def: Profit bots take by ordering transactions: trading just before you, sandwiching your trade, or sweeping leftover funds. On mainnet many bots compete for this in real time.

zh.def: 把两种代币一起存进池子、供别人兑换的人。别人兑换时付的手续费，按份额分给全体 LP。

en.def: Someone who deposits two tokens into a pool so others can swap. Fees from each swap are shared among all LPs by their share.

zh.def: v2 池发给流动性提供者的存款凭证，代表你占池子的份额；可凭它赎回份额和累积手续费。

en.def: A receipt a v2 pool gives a liquidity provider for their share of the pool. Redeem it to withdraw that share plus accumulated fees.

zh.def: 价格变动后，把币放在池子里比一直握在手里少的那部分价值。价格回到原点时它会消失；在偏离时撤出，损失就变实。

en.def: The value you lose by keeping tokens in a pool instead of holding them, after the price moves. It fades if the price returns; withdraw while the price is off and the loss becomes real.

zh.def: Uniswap v3 的做法：LP 只在自选价格区间内提供流动性。同样的钱在区间内更深、手续费更多，但无常损失也更大；价格出区间后不再赚手续费。

en.def: Uniswap v3's design: a liquidity provider supplies only inside a chosen price range. The same money is deeper and earns more fees in range, but impermanent loss is larger, and outside the range it earns nothing.

zh.def: v3 把价格切成约 0.01% 一格的细刻度（价格 ≈ 1.0001 的 tick 次方）。仓位的价格区间用两个 tick 表示。

en.def: v3 divides prices into fine steps of about 0.01% each (price ≈ 1.0001 to the power of the tick). A position's range is given by two ticks.

zh.def: 每一个都独一无二的代币。Uniswap v3 用一个 NFT 代表一个流动性仓位，因为每个仓位区间不同；关闭后可销毁该 NFT。

en.def: A token where every item is unique. Uniswap v3 uses one NFT for one liquidity position because each range differs; after closing it you can burn the NFT.

zh.def: 借贷仓位的覆盖程度：抵押品价值 × 清算阈值 ÷ 债务。大于 1 时别人不能清算；低于 1 才可以。价格下跌只会让这个比值变差，本身不是「开关」。

en.def: How well a loan is covered: collateral value times the liquidation threshold, divided by debt. Above 1, nobody may liquidate; it must fall below 1 first. A lower price only worsens this ratio.

zh.def: 开仓或加借时，债务最多可占抵押品价值的比例。它限制还能借多少，不是跌破后自动清算的那条线。

en.def: The most debt you may hold as a share of collateral value when you open or increase a loan. It limits new borrowing; it is not the line that starts liquidation.

zh.def: 算健康因子时给抵押品价值打的折。通常高于贷款价值比，中间留缓冲。清算看这条线，不看借款上限。

en.def: The discount applied to collateral value when computing the health factor. It is usually higher than the loan-to-value ratio, leaving a buffer. Liquidation uses this threshold, not the borrowing limit.

zh.def: 仓位不健康时，别人主动发交易替借款人还一部分债，并按规则取走一部分抵押品。价格下跌本身不会先扣走抵押品。

en.def: When a loan is unhealthy, someone else sends a transaction, repays part of the debt, and receives some collateral under the protocol's rules. A price drop does not take collateral by itself.

zh.def: 一次清算最多能还掉多少债务的上限，不是每次都必须还满的定额。具体分界取决于部署的协议版本。

en.def: The maximum share of a debt that one liquidation may repay. It is a cap, not an amount always taken. The cutoff depends on the deployed protocol version.

zh.def: 只存在于同一笔交易里的借款：先拿到资金，必须在该交易结束前还上本金和手续费；还不上则资金变动撤销。不要求传统抵押，但仍要付费且有风险。

en.def: A loan that exists only inside one transaction. You receive funds and must repay principal and fee before that transaction ends; if you cannot, fund movements undo. It does not ask for ordinary collateral first, but it still costs a fee and carries risk.

zh.def: 一段时间内价格的平均，而不是只看最后一笔成交。单笔交易更难一下子推偏它；若有人在许多区块里持续推薄池，平均价仍可能被带偏。

en.def: An average of prices over a period, not the latest trade alone. One transaction has a harder time moving it than a spot price. A thin market can still be pushed over many blocks.
